title: Classify REG.RU SMTP transport on 465 and 587 without authentication or sending mail
acceptance: diagnostic is owner-only and bound to release issue 3072
diagnostic is exact-main guarded before and after the network read
diagnostic resolves only the public REG.RU mail endpoint mail.hosting.reg.ru
SMTPS 465 is classified through DNS/TCP/TLS/EHLO and advertised AUTH capability read only
SMTP 587 is classified through DNS/TCP/EHLO/STARTTLS/TLS/post-TLS-EHLO and advertised AUTH capability read only
diagnostic performs no AUTH command and uses no mailbox credential
diagnostic sends no email and performs no password reset
diagnostic does not access the REG.RU production application host, Docker, database or runtime files
only bounded stage classes and boolean capability markers are published
